component.name: Editor
component.summary: Read and lightly edit Markdown, JSON, CSV, configs, logs and code

description.p: A small native viewer and editor for text files: Markdown rendered in a preview pane, JSON as a foldable tree, CSV as aligned columns, and plain config/log/code files in a reading column with light editing. Opens files fast, remembers the session, and updates itself.
Runs everywhere the README's download table claims: Windows (per-user MSI), Linux under X11/XWayland, macOS 12+ as a universal bundle.
